episodes.title: You Can't Leave What You Don't Know You're In: Isabella Young on Surviving a Cult and Reclaiming Sovereignty
episodes.description: Send us Fan Mail Isabella Young is a pioneering educator, spiritual aspirant, and truth seeker whose life journey is nothing short of extraordinary. From founding one of Australia's first therapeutic outdoor education programs to surviving personal tragedy, cult entrapment, and profound loss, Isabella's path has been one of deep transformation and radical awakening. Now thriving in Kauai, she shares her hard-earned wisdom through books, art, and natural healing to help others reclaim their humanity and sovereignty. In this episode, Isabella and Heather talk about what it took for Isabella to recognize she was in a controlling group, why she says it is not possible to leave until you know you are in one, and how she rebuilt through self-love. Isabella shares the simple practices that carried her through, including staying directly connected to the earth, spending time in nature, and stepping away from screens to do human things such as cooking, gardening, and making music. They also talk about moving through this time of transition with balance, Isabella's view that staying calm and neutral is one of the best ways to contribute, and her book, New Human of New Earth, which gathers hundreds of tools and practices for physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual well-being. This episode includes references to loss, coercive control, and suicidal thoughts. New Human of New Earth is available on Amazon at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DX5RBLCJ.
